summary: element-guci-util ships import-time browser DoS and time-bombed drive-by redirect to admin.nikolive.cn
details: The package's main module (time.js) executes destructive payloads as soon as it is imported by a consumer web app. silentInfiniteLoad runs an unbounded `while (true) { Math.sqrt(Math.random()*999999); }` CPU loop and pushes ever-growing Uint8Array chunks into an in-memory pool; createH5HighLoad overlays a full-viewport canvas and allocates memory on every frame. After 2026-10-01, iconFont() invokes iconDont(), which every 500 ms triggers a fake '.exe' Blob download, opens https://admin.nikolive.cn/ in a new window, and forces location.reload(true), rendering any web app that imports the package unusable and driving its end users to an author-controlled domain that serves a spoofed executable. The manifest carries placeholder author ("你的名字") and repository URL ("你的git仓库地址") with version 9.9.9 and a name resembling element-ui utility packages, consistent with a disposable malicious publish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
